reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, s.product_name AS sister_name, s.unit_cost_eur - p.unit_cost_eur AS cost_gap_eur
FROM products p
JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id
WHERE s.unit_cost_eur > p.unit_cost_eur
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, s.product_name AS sister_name, s.unit_cost_eur - p.unit_cost_eur AS cost_gap_eur FROM products s JOIN products p ON p.sister_product_id = s.product_id WHERE p.unit_cost_eur < s.unit_cost_eur
